# Rentmaikar

> Rideshare vehicle rental marketplace serving the USA and Nigeria. Drivers rent
> Uber/Lyft/Bolt-ready vehicles; vehicle owners list their cars for managed,
> passive income. All rentals, payments and communication are mediated by
> Rentmaikar.

Rentmaikar matches rideshare drivers with verified, platform-approved vehicles.
Rentals include maintenance, telematics-backed vehicle tracking, driver training
and insurance subscriptions, with region-aware pricing in USD (USA) and NGN
(Nigeria). Owners earn from their vehicles while Rentmaikar handles driver
vetting, payments and support.
